quote.text: el haber aprendido cómo hay que aceptar los aparentes favores de los amigos, sin dejarse sobornar por ellos ni rechazarlos sin tacto.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • In parenting, learn to accept the thoughtful gestures and support from family and friends, understanding that these signs of care are gifts rather than tools for manipulation.
    • Instill in your children the wisdom to recognize genuine kindness, teaching them to value courtesy while maintaining their own inner balance and independence.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, practice accepting advice and favors with gratitude, but be ever mindful not to let personal alliances cloud your judgment or compromise your integrity.
    • Embrace a measured approach—acknowledge the support from peers and subordinates, yet remain objective and just, ensuring decisions serve the common good and not personal interests.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, welcome insights and suggestions from colleagues and customers, while maintaining a clear vision that is not swayed by fleeting trends or undue influence.
    • Balance input with discernment; carefully weigh recommendations to improve the product without sacrificing the strategic direction that fulfills your long-term goals.
